title: Case of Yang Naiwu and Little Cabbage
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Case of Yang Naiwu and Little Cabbage", at revision 1382378501, opens: "The case of Yang Naiwu and Little Cabbage, officially the death of Zhejiang commoner Ge Pinlian (浙江民人葛品連身死案), was one of the most infamous miscarriages of justice in the Qing dynasty of China. Yang Naiwu (楊乃武), a juren who had just passed the provincial civil service examination, was falsely accused of poisoning Ge Pinlian (葛品連) to death in a conspiracy with Ge's wife nicknamed Little Cabbage in 1873. The case became a cause célèbre as both were forced to admit guilt amid continuous coverage by newspaper Shun Pao. Following multiple appeals and re-trials, the Ministry of Justice handed lenient sentences to Yang, Mrs. Ge, and witnesses accused of perjury. The ministry also fired multiple officials responsible for the unfair convictions." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q5967926, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "murder case of Qing dynasty". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
